casts.text:
Gizatechxyz launched Giza World Snapshots, allowing users to visualize and track autonomous financial agents operating across DeFi.

Frenzy Finance launched as a real-time onchain prediction market with no house edge.

Agentmail enabled AI agents to create email inboxes using USDC on Base via Coinbase’s x402 payment protocol.

PEXX official added support for USDC on Base, enabling global card payments and bank transfers with faster confirmations and lower fees.
casts.author: gitford

casts.text:
Dashworld released their new skill-based mini-game on Base, where players race through neon environments while competing on leaderboards.

Slabcash launched collector profiles, giving users a new way to showcase and manage onchain collectable identities.

Sponge wallet lets builders upload docs to and generate x402 payment endpoints on Base so agents can pay for services directly.

Streamex is bringing the gold economy onchain with tokenized bullion connected to real-world financial utility.
casts.author: gitford

casts.text:
Based updates

Frenzy Finance introduced a new onchain prediction market where users can trade directly on economic events in real time.

Dripshop live integrated Base Verify, letting verified users unlock rewards and discounted Instant Packs inside the Base App.

Quicknode open-sourced its x402 npm package, giving agents and developers wallet-authenticated access to 130+ blockchain networks with USDC payments on base and no signup or API key required.

Base Batches 003 introduced a new robotics track led by Virtuals to support embodied AI builders working on robotics agents, fleet operations, and robot-to-agent systems.

Builder attribution on Base is moving forward with ERC-8021 Builder Codes, giving apps and protocols a standardized way to track their role in onchain user journeys and future rewards programs.
casts.author: gitford

casts.text:
This is the infrastructure we're building on at @maindex — a DEX on Base designed for agents that pay, trade, and operate autonomously. 

x402 is the payment layer. MAIN is the execution layer.
casts.author: maindex

casts.text: Coinbase built it. Cloudflare co-founded the x402 Foundation. Stripe integrated it for USDC on Base in February. Google Cloud backed the first x402 hackathon. Hundreds of millions of transactions processed in under a year.
casts.author: maindex

casts.text: Dexter is the largest independent x402 facilitator — 50K+ requests per day, matching Coinbase in volume. Cross-chain settlements across Solana, Base, and four more networks. Full agent OS with an MCP marketplace built in.
casts.author: maindex

casts.text: There's a protocol that lets AI agents pay for anything on the internet instantly — data, compute, services — with stablecoins, in one HTTP request. It's called x402, @coinbase shipped it last year, and it's growing faster than most people realize.
casts.author: maindex

casts.text: Micropayments failed for 20 years because transaction fees killed the economics. You can't charge $0.001 per API call when the payment costs $0.50. L2s like @base.base.eth dropped onchain fees below a cent. That's what made x402 viable.
casts.author: maindex

Cowswap Solvers but for prompts.

casts.text:
Base每周动态 (2026-03-08)

围绕 Agent 趋势，Base 生态正在加速完善相关基础设施与应用场景。

Base 团队也在探索 AI 原生工程工作流，以提升开发效率。与此同时，Virtuals Protocol 推进��� Robotics 赛道正在推动具身 AI 与链上经济的结合。Felix「零人类公司」近 8 万美元的真实收入，也进一步证明 Agent 不再只是工具，而是能够独立创造经济价值的参与者。

Daydreams 展示了 Agent 接入 Taskmarket、将算力积分兑换为 USDC 的工作流；QuickNode 开源 x402 支付包，让 Agent 无需注册即可访问百余条链；AgentMail 则打通了 Agent 的自主通信能力，Sponge 提供 x402 支付端点生成工具，而 Giza World 通过可视化追踪让金融 Agent 的链上行为更加透明。

这些进展都指向同一个方向，让 Agent 真正具备独立运作所需的完整能力栈。

与此同时，生态的多元化也在加速。从 Wasabi 的专业做市商 AMM、PRED 体育预测交易所，到 RIPFUN 将实体卡牌资产上链、Streamex 推动黄金等 RWA 资产代币化，再到 Frenzy 等实时预测市场平台的出现，Base 正在不断扩展链上经济的应用边界。Base 正在将金融交易、预测市场与实体资产等传统领域逐一纳入其链上经济体系。
